title: Laryngeal Injuries After Anesthesia Induction With Three Different Sevoflurane Concentrations (Without Muscle Relaxant)
brief_summary: Anesthesia induction and tracheal intubation can be performed with and without neuromuscular blocking agents (NMBAs). Tracheal intubation can be performed with sevoflurane instead of NMBAs; intubating conditions are similar and the incidence of vocal cord injuries are similar, too.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* ear-nose-throat surgery
* orotracheal intubation for surgery of the ear
* ASA I-III

Exclusion Criteria:

* obesity
* allergy against the study drugs
* patients with a known or suspected difficult airway
* diseases of the larynx
condition: Other Specified Injuries of Vocal Cord, Sequela
